Phainon hated this clunky feeling body - he was half-way decent at operating it, sure.

But he never quite got used to using magic constantly to make the rest of himself fade away, as if it didn’t exist to anyone around him.

Yet he had to do this.

He couldn’t risk it, never in a hundred years as he sat beside the human he had long since chosen as his mate - eyes daring to catch glimpses of his fellow knight sitting in the same dusty patch in the sparring area wiping the sweat from his own brows.

Mydeimos.

A loyal human (which was appealing in itself, as Phainon was just as loyal towards him specifically), wholly devoted to his oath and protecting the ruler he adored.

And arguably loved.

Those looks in those golden flaked eyes that reminded Phainon of his piles of gold coins drove Phainon insane every time they took a knee together - every time that blonde haired knight looked upwards to the throne. At the king they both had sworn their lives to, the deep level of adoration and love.

Phainon absolutely loathed it.

Hated how blatant it was. How true and pure it was towards that human ruler.. And more importantly how it was never towards him. Those eyes he desired to look at him with all the love and reverence in the world - such mutual things - were reserved for that faceless hooded ruler that never gave Mydeimos an inch.

Never gave him anything, only sat in that throne silently behind his mask and watched them give reports. 

All to send them away again with a flick of his hand - yet Mydei upheld that damnedable oath no matter what.

An oath against love, undying loyalty to him.. All things Phainon found himself craving from Mydei. All things he would equally give in return if he could just.. Manage to sink his claws into that man.

Yet.. 

He was stuck playing knight at his side instead - dreaming of the day this man was his to spoil and adore. Dreaming of the day he could hold him so tenderly and wipe his tears away and whisper sweet nothings into his ears..

Instead.. He was stuck sparring with him, and not giving him the love he deserved. The sparring was fine - but he desperately wished to kiss and dote on him as well during it..

“Are you ready for another round, Mydei?” Phainon asked with a lop-sided smile, a toothy thing as he beamed at the golden haired knight that still was dabbing his own sweat with his shirt. 

“Mm.” Mydei hummed out, eyes flicking to look at Phainon up and down, “Are you? You’re the one that needed a quick break.”

Phainon always needed breaks when it came to sparring with Mydei, the heavy and deep scent of Mydei always made his focus slip when the man started getting worked up. Heavy with the scent of his sweat and somehow sweet honey laced under it all.

He was so intoxicating that Phainon had to take breaks from throwing him around - had to take minutes to control himself and his fiery desires towards the man to make sure his magic was kept under control.

He couldn’t let himself slip, not ever. 

Phainon raised a finger and shook it from side to side all while quietly tutting, “The word ‘quick’ is very important in that sentence, my dear Mydei!”

Mydei huffed at that, looking at Phainon with a raised brow; “Is it? Sometimes you like to nod off in the grass when we take these breaks and fall asleep, you know?”

Phainon had to close his eyes at that, thinking of all the times he had done that in the past.. Only to give a small chuckle as he stared at the fellow golden night who was already dusting himself off - readying up obviously. 

“No. I don’t know. Because you’re thinking of yourself, Mydei.” Phainon corrected and pointed out with a laugh, moving to join Mydei in standing up with a quiet huff.

“Huh. So I am.” Mydei mindlessly said, already messing with his leather gloves he had been wearing for sparring today as his hand seemed to flick slightly. A sign of his own jitteriness that Phainon had grown accustomed to noticing - but never mentioning. 

Phainon copied, flexing his wrist with a small smile as his eyes met those golden ones that were watching him, “Right, right. Another round?”

“I’m always ready.”

Phainon always loved these moments in life - spending them with Mydei. Around Mydei. Sparring with him, training with him, messing up sometimes on purpose so Mydei would roll his eyes dramatically over it yet move to aid him correct himself. 

Yet, sometimes.. He had to win. Had to knock Mydei down, had to rough house with his sturdy and precious mate - tumbling him over to force himself on top.

Something in him craved it, even as he now sat atop him - he craved that feeling of reminding his desired lover what their roles were in bed.. Even if Mydei had no idea of those wishes, even if he had no idea how greedy of a dragon Phainon was.

“I won this round, Mydeimos.” Phainon breathily muttered, still remaining perched on top of Mydei - straddling him easily and locking him down to the floor. Every breath of Phainon’s ragged and raw against his dry throat..

But the more important matter was his hand that was free of his training blade, left on Mydei’s lower stomach - pressing into the soft leather that was there to help shield his flesh from the dull blade’s slice. 

Phainon found himself unable to stop himself, splaying his fingers out across it widely - staring at the length of his hand against his stomach while he sat there. All the while zoned out, blanking out almost as he considered just how deep he could reach in his small human mate..

Too much.

It had to be too much, Phainon’s own hand couldn’t even convey how big he was - and the fact that his hand was already so big..

Humans care about size though, right? Much like dragons do in the way of showing off for their mates?

He was quite sure he had done a decent job of picking an alright size for himself that would impress Mydei and also fit using this human body of his.. But would Mydei want more? Would the length Phainon had picked out not impress Mydei enough? He hadn’t been in the market for a mate when he first started hiding as a human..

.. But now, as his eyes raised up to rather bored and almost confused looking Mydeimos. He desperately wanted a mate.

A specific one.

And only he would do.

“Am I comfortable to sit on?” Mydei asked, tone light and airy, not at all matching his next gruff words as he practically rolled uncomfortably under Phainon - easily knocking him aside and off of him, “Get off me.”

Phainon didn’t mind as he laughed playfully, immediately watching as Mydei straightened himself off to wipe the dust from his body, “Sorry! Sorry.” 

“You are pretty soft though.” Phainon told him with another laugh, after all, Mydei was soft.

Beneath it all, beneath his layers of stoicism, his feelings and actions were incredibly soft and sincere. Gentle things that always made Phainon’s mind spin dizzily. 

“Be quiet.” Mydei growled out, tone not sounding like his normal joking one at all - rough and on edge slightly, and Phainon..

Phainon could smell his irritation beneath it all - heavy and dry to sniff out, a sort of smell that made his nose scrunch up when he sniffed it buried under his normally sweetened smell. 

“Aww.. Grouchy because you lost today?” Phainon purred out, beaming as Mydei moved to rub at his face again - somewhat making himself dirtier due to the dust sticking to his sweat from the ground his hands rubbed on but.. Phainon found himself desperately wishing he could lick him clean, at the least.

Mydei looked at him for a moment, all before moving to offer Phainon a hand, one which Phainon found himself greedily accepting as Mydei yanked him to his feet, “Not really, it’s other things.”

Other things?

Phainon found himself tilting his head over that in pure curiosity - because what could Phainon be unaware of when they were together most of the time, anyway?

“Oh? What’s wearing down my dearest Mydeimos?” Phainon innocently asked, already moving to rub at his own face to stop the sweat beading on his skin. 

“We’re being sent on another scouting mission together to the far reaches of Okhema’s land in two days time.” Mydei hissed out, seeming more and more annoyed with every word as he furrowed his brows - eyes keenly watching Phainon as he spoke.

But Phainon couldn’t really solve the issue there..

“Oh..” Phainon said, as if he understood before nodding his head quickly, “More time with you! Isn’t that fun?”

Mydei stared at him, a twitch in his jaw, a small jittery movement.. All before scoffing, “.. I don’t like going over there.”

Phainon had to blink over those words, trying his best to understand why Mydei felt that way. But really, he had nothing. 

“Why is that?”

Mydei looked uncomfortable over the question - golden eyes looking at Phainon for a long moment all before moving them away. Focusing on his own hands almost nervously before he quietly spoke.

“The dragon’s lair is over there.”

──────────────

“Phainon..” 

Phainon found himself rousing at that sweet voice - the voice he always fought the urge to trill over happily, the desire to purr and nuzzle into the speaker rising in him. All while forcing himself to sit up slowly, drowsily staring at the man who was looking at the entrance of his tent.

Not even looking at Phainon - eyes seeming to avoid it if anything as he looked into the distant woods, seemingly focused on something else. 

“You’re awake. Get dressed, we need to march onwards soon.” Mydei informed him, tone sounding more rigid now that Phainon was rousing from his slumber, “I made breakfast as well.”

And just like that, Mydei was gone - immediately vanishing from Phainon’s sight with a loud sigh.

Phainon had to roll over once he heard that man stepping away - yanking his blanket down to stare at the roof of his tent. 

He hated missions like this, namely because it was the spring and during the spring Mydei didn’t let him crawl into his tent to snuggle for ‘warmth’. So instead he was stuck within a few feet away from the love of his life all while having to sleep without him. Without being able to curl into him or hold him or kiss him or groom him or..

Phainon had to thump his tail angrily at the floor over his thoughts loudly.

.. His tail?

He jolted at that, eyes immediately dashing to look at that long white scaled tail sitting innocently to the side of him. Phainon’s eyes slowly trailed down it widely - doing his best not to think of the fact Mydei must have seen it. 

Surely he.. He hadn’t missed it? Mydei hadn’t said anything about it, though?

Did he really not notice it?

Phainon had to make it vanish again with his own magic before scrambling to put on his boots - postponing actually getting ready for the day in favor of asking Mydei a hundred questions. Or, well, maybe seeing if Mydei had a hundred for him. 

But now, as he stood outside of his tent - staring at the back of Mydei’s head.. He could only feel his body trembling under the weight of Mydei hating him. The idea of Mydei forever having his back to him like that - forever refusing to look at him. Or worse, trying to kill Phainon for the crime of being a dragon.

His hands twitched over all those ideas, moving slowly to the side of Mydei to sit down on the blanket Mydei had already put out beside a now extinguished dying down fire. One that Mydei seemed to have used to lightly toast some bread with eggs. 

“Good morning Mydeimos!” Phainon greeted, despite the fact his hands were quivering with no way of stopping - terrified as he stared Mydei down who looked.. Almost bored as he moved a small cloth towards Phainon, one with a slice of bread and some of those eggs on it already.

“Morning,” Mydei replied in his usual  tone, not betraying a thing before he sighed as Phainon took the food from him. 

And Phainon.. Didn’t know what to make of that. Mydei smelled fine, nothing was off about his scent, it was the same old calm Mydei as ever.. Had he really just.. Not noticed Phainon’s tail earlier? Phainon was pretty sure it was extremely obvious and yet..?

“The dragon’s lair is north,” Mydei mumbled out, unaware of Phainon’s growing confusion, eyes already focusing on the wooded area stretching out there way before sighing loudly, “I’d.. Prefer to avoid it.”

Phainon had to take a bite out of his bread at that, mind puzzling over those words and his own thoughts before he hummed, “Why? Hasn’t the dragon been missing for a long time?”

Of course it had, after all, he was the one that lived there.. Something Mydei should have noticed today, right?

“.. It has.” Mydei agreed, moving to prop his head up on his hand with a heavy sigh, “But I’m not keen on the idea of the dragon being tucked away in there under its wealth sleeping, or coming home to us there.”

Nothing betrayed the fact Mydei didn’t know however. He was acting the same as always, disdainful towards dragons, and stoic and full of  yawns in the early mornings. 

Phainon had to huff over that, giving a small laugh before moving to eat more of his breakfast - honestly. He hated eggs (for deeply personal and upsetting reasons), but since they were made by Mydei he could never find the strength to refuse and eagerly ate them every time..

.. But due to that Mydei also just assumed he really liked eggs. There was no winning in this situation. 

“I never knew you to be such a coward.” Phainon teased once he swallowed his food politely, very aware of those golden eyes narrowing and staring him down over his laughter at the situation. 

“Dragons are said to be extremely possessive of their things, I’d rather not impede.” Mydei instantly and rather flatly explained - seeming less than enthused over it all but that was even funnier for Phainon to consider.

Moving his gaze to focus in the direction Mydei had been glaring at, the direction of his own home. 

Dragons are extremely possessive.

Ironic words to come from the man Phainon wanted so badly that it ached inside, it burned and clawed into him roughly and cruelly. It dug into him and burrowed deeper every time Mydei sweetly cared for him, sweetly reminded him what he couldn’t have.

Possessive? Horribly so. 

He desperately wanted this man to belong to him, and only him. His riches? Mydei could have those, so long as at the end of the day - Mydei returned to him.

That’s all he wanted..

“What if the dragon invited you in?” Phainon innocently asked, flicking his eyes to Mydei with a raised brow almost playfully. Mainly because he was curious now.. Had Mydei truly not seen his tail? 

Mydei looked beyond baffled over that, head jutting backwards with wide eyes as he tried to understand what Phainon was asking of him; “..Huh?”

Phainon took another bite at that, eyes staring right back at the questioning amber ones that were wide as all hells now, “If the dragon themself invited you into their lair, would you go in?”

That was his clarification, yet Mydei only blinked over it, tilting his head before taking a bite of his own food. Almost numbly appearing however - seeming like he needed something to do while he considered it.

“What is with this kind of trick question?” Mydei eventually asked as he swallowed his bite of food, giving a huff of amusement out of his nose almost over it, “No. It most likely would mock my foolishness and greed towards its hoard of riches, probably.”

Phainon had to hum over that, leaning back onto his hands as he forewent his food for just a minute - staring towards his own home. He wasn’t wrong to think that - dragons were very territorial and greedy, they didn’t frequently get along with their own kind due to that.

But Phainon had to flicker his eyes to Mydei over his own thoughts, blinking over how this man was not a fellow dragon at all. He lacked the greed - as selfless as ever, really. All while being the thing Phainon was arguably most territorial over. 

“What if they were friendly, and just wanted a companion?” Phainon offered up in earnest, shooting him a small smile, one that Mydei immediately looked away from swiftly. Instead, focusing on his own hands dully.

“.. I doubt I would suit that need.”

Phainon had to blink over that.

Stunned as he tilted his head, eyes staring at Mydei who seemed to be avoiding that gaze now almost like he was embarrassed or something. Though.. Phainon didn’t quite understand that, was it embarrassment.. Or something that he didn’t see often enough so clearly written on Mydeimos to name?

.. Sorrow?

Phainon wasn’t sure what to make of that expression as he furrowed his brows, “Why not?”

“What is with this line of questioning..? Would you go into a dragon’s lair if you were invited in?” Mydei immediately hissed out in blatant deflection, but Phainon didn’t mind as he chuckled over the question - shaking his head a bit before moving to take a bite of his own food.

Phainon shrugged, “Certainly. It sounds like a lovely time, what if they.. I don’t know, wanted to cover me in their riches and keep me safe?”

After all, that’s what he wanted to do to Mydei - along with pamper and adore him, love him, cherish him, hold him dear, protect him.. The list goes on..

“And why would a dragon want to do that to a human?” Mydei asked with a small laugh, a disbelieving thing that made Phainon truly come to terms that Mydei hadn’t seen his tail. 

At least, probably not considering how this conversation was going.. 

Phainon had to laugh as well, not as painful sounding as Mydei’s - but because he knew a simple answer to it all either way; “Well.. Dragons do like pretty things!”

“Wow, confident, aren’t we?” Mydei asked with a roll of his eyes, now finishing up his food and instead just sitting there chatting.. An incredibly simple thing that always made Phainon feel giddy to have all to himself..

“Haha..” Phainon was more than confident, after all.. “Isn’t that why a dragon would enjoy you, too?”

Mydei stilled at that, no longer moving to straighten himself out - once again freezing to give Phainon an indecipherable expression over those words; “Hmm?”

Phainon had to chuckle over the reaction, smiling fondly as he hummed out over Mydei staring at him. Basking in the attention squarely focusing on him.. 

“Gold hair.. Gold eyes.. You’re all of their favorite things, I’m sure a dragon would love to stare at you sitting on top of their piles of gold.” Phainon had thought about it so many times, about how this man who went on expeditions and scoutings in linens and leathers would look so delicious covered in gold.

Weighed down with heavy commanding footsteps due to the sheer volume of gold jewelry Phainon wished he could place onto him lovingly..

“.. I doubt a dragon would enjoy a human basking in their wealth.” Was what Mydei’s thoughts instead were on the matter, making Phainon laugh as he watched Mydei go back to patting the fire out - clearly finished with it and now messing with the ash more than the charcoal still red with life.

Phainon couldn’t help but notice that as well, keenly watching the way Mydei moved so elegantly and precisely, all of his muscles constraining in the perfect ways under his shirt sleeves that..

Phainon had to look away, giving a small chuckle as he cleared his own thoughts regarding Mydei’s body.

“You never know! You should ask one.” Phainon mused as he looked at the tree line of their small makeshift camp - staring in the direction of the place people called his home.

But nowadays, it moreso felt like his home was wherever this man took him to - staying by his side no matter what, for whatever Mydei wanted. Until Mydei decided that one day he didn’t need a partner, that he was fine to be a knight alone and handle his duties without a comrade to watch his back.

.. Phainon wasn’t sure if his heart could manage to bear it when the day eventually came.

Mydei, however, only laughed at the idea innocently, “Ask who? A dragon?”

“Yes, why not?” Phainon fired back without missing a beat, flitting his eyes back to watch Mydei as the man stood up - all to stretch with his arms over his head before leaning side to side lazily. 

“Well, for starters, they’re a dragon.” Mydei said as he moved his eyes back to Phainon, quirking a brow upwards, “Not exactly known for being friends with humans.”

Phainon found himself taking a last savory bite of his bread and eggs before giving a small laugh, “On the contrary, I hear dragons prefer finding human mates instead of fellow dragons!”

Mydei looked stunned over that, eyes widening as he stared downwards at Phainon - mouth agape before closing it. All to close his eyes as well as if deeply debating something before giving a small and oddly cold chuckle. 

Shaking his head slowly in disbelief as he opened his eyes, only to smirk at Phainon, “.. Where in the seven hells did you hear a thing like that?”

“A book I read once.”

“.. They should burn that book for insane heresy.”

──────────────

Phainon had to sneak away.

Of course he did - Mydei’s scent was too strong, and his current state of mind was rapidly failing him. He thought he was stronger than this, but he was finding out.. He absolutely wasn’t.

He was a weak, weak dragon for that man.. Plus, they had found a rather clear lake nearby, and Phainon wasn’t against cleaning himself off from the day in some water.. Sure he had no soap that humans loved to use. But that was fine, anything to feel a little bit clear of mind as he dunked his head beneath the top of it with a huff.

He adored Mydei.

Which was why it sucked so badly when he had to bite down his feelings and act like it was fine constantly. Especially as his instincts yelled at him constantly, nipping into him that he was his. Mydei was his mate, he needed to take him home, love him, dote on him..

Yet he couldn’t. He had to suffer and act like he didn’t crave that man more than air. Even the thought frustrated him as he dragged his eyes to the night sky - trying his best not to think of the man already fast asleep under the moon by now.. 

At least, he could hum to himself that ever familiar melody as he lowered himself deeper into the waters. Up to his ears as he hummed that soft yet somber melody, the one that had always haunted him - but he could never clearly remember the full thing, anyway.

A distant memory he longed to clutch for, yet it always felt hopeless to try - thus, he was doomed to repeat that endless melody again and again brokenly.

“Do you always sing while you’re bathing?”

Phainon jolted slightly at that - rather glad he kept himself fully submerged into that chilled night water as he turned to look at the speaker, especially considering he could feel the way his scales were on his skin.. 

Probably not visible due to the lighting being merely the moon, and their milky white translucent coloring. 

“Hmm?” Phainon hummed out innocently as he blinked at the way Mydei was already tugging off his own shirt, “Hello Mydeimos! Are you here to join me?”

“I am.” Mydei answered without missing a beat as he threw his linen shirt to the side - hands moving to undo his belt as well..

“Wonderful, I was singing to serenade you, in particular, anyway!” Phainon beamed out - a joke, all things considered, but deep down in his heart.. It all was for him at the end of the day. 

Dragons didn’t serenade their mates, but purring for them wasn’t out of the question when happy - giving them soft trills and noises of happiness.. If Phainon closed his eyes hard enough, and deluded himself just the right amount, he could see it as a bonding activity.

.. But Phainon found himself turning away from the man - not daring to impede on his beloved mate’s privacy as he removed his pants and underwear. 

“Wow, how joyful for me.” Mydei huffed out, a teasing tone that Phainon knew so well as Mydei also sank himself into the water. Only, Phainon wasn’t given a chance to reply. 

“What is the melody you’re humming anyway? Doesn’t seem to have lyrics.” Mydei followed up with a question, making Phainon’s face burn in wonder of just how long Mydei had been listening to him. 

Not that Phainon minded! Just.. If he had known he would have sung his best, even more! Or something, he really wasn’t sure but for some reason he knew he was embarrassed..

“I don’t remember.” Phainon conceded as he moved a hand to pat at his own cheek idly, trying his best to make the red blush he could feel subside,“I just know it’s dear to me.”

Mydei hummed over that, a gentle thing as he moved to sink even more into the waters as Phainon eyed him; “.. Is that so?”

A genuine question, one that made Phainon almost wish he could remember the significance of it - but his memory was a bit splotchy in some areas of his life. He could only honestly recall that melody and loop it.

“Very. Would you like to hear it?” Phainon purred out his question - grinning at the man who stared at him for a second. All before immediately sinking into the water fully, dunking himself swiftly before bobbing right back up to his chest being exposed.

The soaked golden cat now leered at Phainon before moving a hand to move his now sopping wet bangs off his face. All to nod curtly at Phainon, “Go ahead.”

Phainon turned away at that - mainly because it was almost too shameful to stare at Mydei and sing to him. And he didn’t dare inquire why Mydei let out the faintest little gasp as he did so - he could only pray it was the chill water finally getting to him.

All to begin that melody again as he always had, quietly singing out the wordless verses with his borderline hum as he sat there. 

It was mindless, really, a habit of sorts to sing that tune when he was alone - the idea of Mydei hearing it wasn’t that bad either. After all, he wanted to share everything he owned and was with Mydeimos the most.

Only.. 

“.. You have a nice voice.” Mydei eventually said after a few loops of that same almost somber melody that Phainon was repeating.

And that was enough to make Phainon immediately move to face him again, beaming widely at the man who was earnestly praising him so sweetly. 

“Do I? That means a lot from you, Mydei!” Phainon practically felt himself purring out - because it did. He would do anything for Mydei, especially as he watched Mydei’s lips quirk upwards into a small smile. 

“You would have done well as the court jester.” Mydei told him, and that made Phainon tilt his head.

Not exactly what he had in mind but.. 

“.. Okay, come on now.” Phainon pouted out, feeling himself sink a bit lower into the waters as he blew bubbles out of his mouth - not letting his nose go under. And a piece of his desperately wished he could swish and slap his tail against the water in frustration instead of hiding that piece of himself away from Mydei.

But it didn’t matter anyway as Mydei watched him, all before giving a laugh. A full heart-felt thing that made Phainon’s heart flutter and his mind swoon immediately over hearing his mate be so openly happy.

So happy in the comfort of the both of them alone.

“I jest, it’s good.” Mydei nodded as he finished his laughter - moving his hands to wipe at his own face with the water now before sighing softly over it.

Probably in relief of getting some of the grime off of himself from the day.

“Thank you, thank you!” Phainon happily took that compliment, “I’ll be here all.. How much longer will we be here?”

Mydei’s eyes flitted to him over that, all before smiling and chuckling again with a small shake of his head as his eyes moved to look at the moon above them both.

“Hmph.” He huffed out, a noise Phainon knew well to be the man scolding him without actually using his words, clearly over the fact he didn’t know how long they would continue to be journeying,  “A day or so, and then we need to head back.”

But Phainon had never been good with telling humans’s tracking of time. It seemed like such a waste of effort, but maybe it was just that important considering their short life spans.. Not that Phainon was worried over such a thing. 

He could fix that for Mydei, if the man would just let him. If the man would.. Just be his lover. 

“Right, right. I’ll be here for a few more hours if you would like to hear me continue my singing.” Phainon hummed out in response, grinning over the fact he would indeed sing for Mydei as long as he wanted.

He had no qualms of being a sweet songbird for his dearest, anyway. If it made Mydei happy, he was more than just a little happy to sing this song, again and again. Until Mydei grew sick of it and told him to knock it off..

Anything, for Mydeimos. 

Mydei moved at that, to the edge of the grass before crossing his arms and planting his head down on top of them - looking so very tired. And yet, his golden eyes were still focused on Phainon, still giving him all the attention Phainon always craved from the man that belonged to him in a deep way.

Even if Mydei was unaware of that fact.

“Go ahead.” Mydei told him after getting comfortable on the water’s edge, body still halfway submerged as Phainon’s eyes raked over it a bit shamefully. But truly, Mydei had such a perfect body he couldn’t help but gawk over how well he could most likely handle his children. 

Perfect in every way..

Mydei’s fingers dug into Phainon’s tail as Phainon swiftly returned to thrusting into him - ruthlessly pushing and pulling pleasure from those warm clenching insides that were still milking him so sweetly. 

And that was more than intoxicating as his eyes stared at the back of Mydei’s head - drinking in the way Mydei was just whimpering as letting it happen. Letting that third egg easily push into him and slide deeper to join the other two inside of him.

All while he gave no fight, no complaints outside quiet little whimpers over the pressure of Phainon still fucking him - still pounding away all before Phainon conceded. He had to as he came inside of Mydei, pushing that ovipositor as deep as he could with a loud unadulterated moan leaving his own lips as Mydei’s body twitched around him.

It was blindingly good, everything he had ever wanted - stars dotting his vision as he tried to move.. Tried to focus on what he truly was more concerned with..

“They’re all in..” Phainon panted out, all while moving his hand to gently rub at Mydei’s stomach - now able to feel the bulge of all three eggs being buried inside of him. Staying lodged into there now that his own body accepted its role as a dragon’s mate.

And Phainon trilled loudly and happily over that, rubbing that swelling stomach his hand soothingly - completely foregoing moving or thrusting anymore to ride out his orgasm in favor of doting on his now expecting mate. 

“How did you-” Mydei started, cutting himself off to take such a deep breath before finishing his thoughts, “Just have these inside of you?”

“Same way I have a tail and horns only sometimes..” Phainon laughed out in earnest as he moved to press a kiss to Mydei’s shoulder while bending over him, “Magic.”

“I don’t.. Like how smart ass-y that sounds, yet is your actual explanation, isn’t it?”

“It is.”

Mydei sighed so very loudly at that, a sound that made Phainon almost question if Mydei was angry at him as he tilted his head to the side. But Mydei settled on another line of thought instead of growing at Phainon over that explanation. 

“Put me.. Down.”

“Are you sure? I..” Phainon trailed off as he thought about that demand, eyes moving to look around for a decent spot as he slowly dragged his hips backwards - fully exiting Mydei fully.

“Put me down, Phainon..” Mydei reiterated, and Phainon.. Whimpered over it as he slowly set his leaking mate down onto the cum soiled gold beneath him. Probably could to the touch as well as Mydei breathed heavily and just completely collapsed as soon as he hit the floor.

“Are you alright, Mydei..?” Phainon asked gently, eyes worryingly staring at that man who still had his own eyes closed - looking so very exhausted as he stayed on that pile of gold. 

“.. Yes.” Mydei eventually managed out as he seemed to struggle to even rise to his feet - not that it mattered as Phainon immediately shot out to grab the man and shuffle him into his arms. Not even bothering to ask as he picked him up easily. 

Not like Mydei put up a fight either, huffing out one odd noise as he allowed himself to be lifted from the ground.

“I’m going to move you onto my bed, alright?” Phainon cooed out as he swiftly moved, ignoring the sound of jingling with every movement as he quickly fumbled through his collection of wealth.

Mydei scoffed so loudly over that, “You own.. A bed? And we had sex on some hard metal?”

‘On some hard metal’.

Phainon tilted his head at that, eyes flickering to the man who was assuredly almost trembling in his arms due to over exertion. 

“To be fair, I didn’t think it mattered too much when I was holding you off the ground for it..” Phainon pointed out fondly, almost feeling weak in the knees again even considering the fact he had kept Mydei in the air during sex so easily with his tail. Even while impregnating him with their children..

“Put me in your bed, you demon.” Mydei demanded, and Phainon.. Was powerless to do anything but obey his now plump mate. 

“Dragon. Not a demon.” Phainon mindlessly corrected, already stalking off and down those piles of gold with nimble feet - practiced in the art of waddling through gold. Even if there was now a beautiful man snuggled into his arms.

But he couldn’t stop his eyes from repeatedly flickering to Mydei, watching his chest heave up and down so harshly.. “You’re still breathing heavily.. Are you truly alright?”

“You try having three eggs pushed into your insides and then struggle to adapt to your guts and organs moving around, and then tell me how easy your breath comes to you.” Mydei growled out, golden eyes snapping upwards to leer at Phainon and well..

Phainon had to concede, nodding slowly over that idea, “.. That sounds uncomfortable.”

“It is.”

“I guess it’s fair you’re grouchy then..”

“I’m not grouchy, I’m rather content right now actually.” Mydei corrected, voice growing softer as Phainon continued to easily navigate to his old rickety bed he had kept here while still adapting to being in his fleshy human form and keeping his magic going.

.. Magic he knew must be failing him, as he glanced at his arms to see those white scales flaking his skin - assuredly all over his body now as well. Not like it mattered anymore, the most important person to keep that secret from knew very well what he was anyway..

“Are you?” Phainon asked as he discarded his thoughts.

“Quite. Just uncomfortably full inside.” Mydei mumbled out, blinking as he turned his head to look at that blue silken bed Phainon had stopped to the side of, “.. Your bed is dusty.”

“Well! I’ve been away from home playing knight. Hold on.” Phainon laughed out, all before turning slightly to idly brush it away with his tail - thankful the underbelly of it was soft enough to do at least that before he moved it deftly to tug those covers back.

All before lowering Mydei neatly into that bed - tucking him easily with his hands as he patted the man down. Blinking over the way Mydei was keenly watching his every move, all while Phainon found himself sitting at the edge of that bed. Tail thumping beside him as he innocently watched Mydei.

All before Mydei seemed to furrow his brows, “.. Are you not sleeping with me?”

Sleeping.. With him?

“Am I allowed to!?” Phainon asked, perking up even more than he had thought possible as he felt his tail return to wagging across the floor of that cave he had made himself happily and energetically. 

“You.. Made me take some soul binding blood oath to you, pumped me full of children, and then think we cannot sleep in the same bed together..?” Mydei growled out, eyes narrowing all while Phainon could hear his tail thumping behind him in his excitement - still sitting at the side of the bed and staring at those golden eyes.

Staring over the edge of the bed contently before giving a small hum over those words; “Well I.. I didn’t want to overstep your boundaries, you know?”

Only, Mydei looked less than thrilled to hear those words as he seemed to instantly grimace and then pull his face into such a heavy frown that Phainon had to fight the urge to whimper over that reaction from his mate.

“You are insufferable. Get in the bed with me right now, Phainon, and give me aftercare.” Mydei hissed at him, clearly having enough of Phainon’s antics and well.. Phainon didn’t find it in himself to make that last any longer as he practically leapt upwards and into the bed beside Mydei. 

“Okay!” Was all he said as he scrambled to fit himself under the covers with his waiting mate who had turned to face him, only - Phainon awkwardly shuffled his weight, trying to figure out the best way to cuddle this man. 

“Tail around me.” Mydei demanded, and Phainon didn’t waste a single breath delaying as he moved his tail under those silken sheets to wrap around Mydei gently. Just tight enough to keep him there, to keep him safely in Phainon’s grasp, “Good boy.”

Phainon had to move closer to Mydei at that praise - nuzzling his head into Mydei’s own as the blond haired man immediately leaned into him. Clearly seeking out more of that contact all while Phainon couldn’t help the rumbling in his chest. Hands moving to pet Mydei's hair idly as it started up.

“.. Are you purring?” Mydei asked after a few silent seconds, a question that made Phainon’s face burn in embarrassment so instantly. Burning as he immediately coughed to clear his throat - ceasing that annoying rumbling that was assuredly bothering his sweet mate.

“Sorry..” Phainon mumbled softly, doing his best to keep his trills and purrs to himself - all while he felt Mydei only lean into him.

“It’s cute.. Keep doing that.” Mydei hushedly replied into Phainon’s chest, “I’m tired and it's soothing..”

Phainon hummed over that - deigning not to actually respond as he tucked his arms further under Mydei, pressing that man as close as possible all while keeping his tail coiled around him protectively. Lowly trilling repeatedly over the situation, all before his own hand ghosted to Mydei’s stomach. 

Just to gently and tenderly rub him in soothing circles, thankful that his tail was wrapped around Mydei or else he would easily be slapping his tail into the bed at mach speed..

This was all he had ever wanted, to happily have Mydei in his arms resting - safe and away from the troubles of their life as knights - merely together for the rest of their days.

“Good night, my dear Mydeimos.” Phainon found himself purring out his words - nuzzling his head into the top of Mydei’s own lovingly. Addicted to the way Mydei was holding onto him just as tightly, seeking out his warmth just as much as Phainon was. 

Phainon could only pray that Mydei’s greed towards him would rival a dragon’s as well..

──────────────

“Are you sure it’s safe for me to be.. Traveling like this?” Mydei asked from Phainon’s side, and that was something that made Phainon bite down the urge to laugh at his partner - not in a mocking way. But because he did look much more.. Full and rounder than once before as he walked on that familiar beaten dirt path.

Familiar, due to the way they had always walked like this side by side, even if the path itself was actually leading to somewhere completely foreign to both of them.

Phainon had to raise a brow over that as he looked to Mydeimos, blinking at the lack of heavy armor and leather for usual traveling - now wearing much more basic civilian-like clothing. Due to it being more comfortable against his skin (something Mydei had grown used to hissing about, and Phainon could only infer it was a side effect from being.. Well, rather pregnant), and not hugging him as tightly.

“Mm.. Well! You said you feel fine and can walk fine, so people will probably assume you’ve just got a wine belly from being a wealthy retired knight!” Phainon hummed out in a giddy tone, mainly due to the fact Mydei couldn’t handle his wine at all. 

The idea of him having a potbelly due to such a thing made Phainon grin all the more as Mydei bumped their shoulders together with a heavy scoff. 

“.. Ridiculous.” Mydei grumbled out, but Phainon had to hum over that easily. Mainly due to the fact he frequently caught Mydei gently rubbing his own stomach time and time again, and now was no different as Mydei seemed to try to soothe those eggs incubating inside of him.

A silly thing, really, it’s not like the eggs could feel it..

.. But Phainon sure as hell wasn’t going to tell him that, instead enjoying watching the sweet attempts from his mate to care for their children.

“I mean you can try to tell them that’s your eggs from your dragon mate, if you want. I’m sure they’ll believe you!” Phainon happily told Mydei, nodding his head as he spoke his own words because he could assuredly already hear the drunken rambles of people laughing and giggling over Mydei believing he had dragon eggs inside of him.

.. And then they would probably promptly lock him away for having lost his mind, but Phainon was sure a prison escape would be easy enough for him to figure out! If not, he wasn’t against breaking a few walls quietly!

“Fair point.” Mydei conceded with a quiet laugh leaving him, waving a hand as he moved it away from his stomach dismissively.

But Phainon found himself moving closer to Mydei - knocking their shoulders together all while beaming at the man, “Speaking of, you said this town is well known for its dairy?”

Mydei’s head snapped to stare at Phainon over those words - a glare harsh and burning in his eyes as they walked together. One that made Phainon raise his brows innocently as he stared at his gorgeous husband. 

The fact he had well.. Weighed down Mydei in blue jewels and gold made Phainon want to swish his tail over the sight time and time again. Mydei deserved to be covered in golden jewelry like he was now, even if it became a problem of showing off and maybe even bandits - Phainon was not above eating them for a stomach ache for Mydei.

Even if Mydei huffed about it being heavy - at least the man had kept the earring and necklace Phainon had picked out for him from his hoard of wealth.. While throwing off the other amounts of jewels Phainon had trilled and covered him in after a while of letting Phainon play dressup with it all.

“.. I’m extremely worried for our children that this topic is a ‘speaking of’ scenario for you.” Mydei grumbled out, shaking his head before focusing ahead again, “But yes, they have herds of cows, goats, and chickens that rival every other kingdom.”

Phainon had to nod over that, he didn’t know much about the human towns as of late - he had been used to only paying attention to Okhema due to Mydei’s entire existence.. And even when he spent his days as a dragon lounging around, he hadn’t been too interested in the smaller outskirt towns.

“Wow.. We’re traveling to see cheese..” Phainon slowly riddled out with a slow nod, one that - even though his head was staring at the dirt trail in front of him - he could feel those golden eyes looking at him with such a flabbergasted expression.

All before a heavy sigh escaped Mydei loudly.

“Don’t frame it like that.” Mydei chastised, “It’s on the way to the ocean’s edge, anyway.”

The ocean’s edge. 

Even from passing conversations Mydei had always seemed like his mind was elsewhere - and for some reason the sea had been one of the main things. Not like Phainon could judge him for that, however, if anything he wanted to help Mydei live by the sea like he desired. 

.. Plus Phainon didn’t think it to be a bad place to raise children, anyway!

“You really want to go to the beach, huh?” Phainon idly asked as he continued their brisk pace, amused slightly that his partner still wanted to wander the world all while round and expecting. Not like Phainon minded, anyway. 

He had offered to fly him safely around in his claws, regardless.. But Mydei turned the idea down - for now at least.. Mumbling something about stress being bad for children and Phainon.. Didn’t dare bring up the fact he didn’t think eggs would be affected by his moods and what he ate.

Mydei shrugged under Phainon’s gaze at that, all before giving a small hum, “Not sure, really. I don’t like the water.”

“Huh!?”

“You know this..” Mydei mumbled out as he continued his steady pace, sighing loudly over Phainon’s reaction. Mainly because Mydei was right - Phainon was very aware of such a thing but it didn’t help his sanity any.

Especially considering by all technical terms; Mydei was now expecting their children..

Phainon had to move a hand to rub at his neck slowly, feeling his hair sticking to him under the heat of the sun - and he had half of his mind to  question if Mydei didn’t at least want Phainon’s wings out to offer him some shade politely..

Yet another piece of him knew his mate would growl at him over that with ‘what if someone sees’ etc etc. 

All he could do was sigh, “Well, yes. But it doesn’t make it any less shocking that you want to go to the beach while hating the beach..”

“Mm..” Mydei immediately hummed, kicking at the dirt a little as he walked heavily, “Someone once told me he would replace my bad memories with good ones, you know? I’m just making sure he stays good on his promise.”

Phainon had to laugh over that, over how long ago it seemed where he had thought Mydei wished to be dancing with that king they both had wholly abandoned. An entire kingdom that Mydei had finally escaped from - a prisoner of Kremnos’s war no longer, since, after all.

Both of them should be dead from waking the dragon that had been seen coming and going from its den as of late..

“Oh!” Phainon chirped happily at his own thoughts innocently, “Oh that’s me huh..”

“.. Don’t say it like that.” Mydei chastised, but he equally sounded like he was joking beneath it all - and Phainon could tell that much with those vibrant eyes twinkling playfully as Phainon gave him a lop-sided grin. Moving to instead walk sideways as he focused on Mydei. 

“I’m joking! I’m very happy to spend the rest of my days making only good memories with my beloved Mydeimos, mind you!” Phainon assured him sweetly, giving a small laugh all before immediately moving to Mydei to grasp his hands. Easily halting the man’s walking to begin peppering his face in small kisses.

All while his hands snaked around his waist to hold him there - firmly pressing Mydei into the kiss all while the man huffed out quiet little laughs over the sweet gestures of chaste kisses being applied all over his face. 

“Stop-” Mydei tried to reprimand, faltering slightly as he kept giving way to soft laughter instead, “Stop kissing me so much.”

Phainon had to pause at that, playfully staring at his beloved as he grinned over the way Mydei remained in his arms. Merely staring right back at him with the most fond of expressions, a thing Phainon now knew was truly for him, and no one else.

A thing he adored so very deeply, just like every single piece of Mydei he had ever learned about. 

“You’re saying that, yet you’re so happy and giggling..” Phainon practically purred out his teasing, unable to keep his hands off of the man as he moved to press another kiss to his jaw. Trailing down with more and more kisses all while that man scoffed and shook his head slowly over the abundance of affection.

Mydei gave a small noise as he placed a hand on Phainon’s chest to lightly press on him - the world’s most feeble attempt to escape as he sighed loudly, “I’m always happy with you.”

“Wow.. Sappy..” Phainon hummed out so very lowly - mainly because he already knew his next plan of attack against this man, “You better stop.. I’m not good at not being greedy with you now..”

And with those words Phainon moved quickly to hook an arm under Mydei’s knees all while still supporting his back - and swiftly applied just a decent amount of force to pick the man up. 

“Wait-”

Phainon didn’t wait, of course he didn’t - not as he easily picked that man off his feet and swung him into a bridal carry. Grinning all the while over the way Mydei’s arms immediately flung around his neck to hold onto him. 

Just for a moment before he was stabilized and safe in Phainon’s arms, instead dropping one to once more rub at his own stomach soothingly. As if Phainon’s brisk movements would damage the poor eggs buried inside of him safely (Phainon wasn’t sure if Mydei understood just how sturdy those eggs were, but he was rather fond of Mydei being such a doting thing that he didn’t dare point it out.).

“I’ll carry you! My sweet princess deserves to be pampered!” Phainon hummed out as he continued walking easily - after all, Mydei weighed next to nothing if Phainon actually let himself relax and seep just a bit into his true self. 

“Princess?!” Mydei parroted out in a confused tone, one that made Phainon bubble into laughter as he happily carried that man - grinning at those golden eyes that were staring in shock and bafflement towards him over that name being used for him of all people.

Phainon laughed over that, feeling as light-hearted as ever as he kept his steady pace forward - he would probably be skipping along if he wasn’t halfway worried Mydei would hiss at him over being rough with their children. As if dragon eggs were exactly thin skinned and easy to scramble inside of him.

“Aren’t princesses the one dragons steal in fairy tales? You’re mine in this life!” Phainon cooed out as he gave another wide grin to that man who was now almost sulking in his arms.

Almost.

He wasn’t very good at the act due to the way he was rather blatantly leaning into Phainon, clearly enjoying the weight off his feet even if he said it wasn’t a big deal.. Phainon was quite sure the extra weight was annoying after a while of walking, and he didn’t mind carrying all of Mydei and their children!

“I would be almost insulted..” Mydei’s hand gripped Phainon’s chin harshly at that, ripping his gaze from the road and back to the man snuggly in his arms, “If I wasn’t hopelessly enamored by you.”

Phainon had to pause his feet at that - all to immediately give Mydei another soft little kiss. One to his lips this time. An innocent and sweet thing, just one truly cementing their affection for each other that was now blood thick to both of their cores. 

“It’s very mutual, my beloved..” Phainon mumbled out as he pulled away from those lips that called to him like a siren, eyes staring into those golden ones. 

Golden eyes that seemed to slowly narrow in his seriousness, all before his lips curved upwards in almost a mocking way, “It better be, or else I know where you keep all your gold.”

Phainon had to fakely whimper over that, not really feeling threatened at all.. Especially considering the fact he had begged and pleaded for Mydei to take some of his jewels and gold several times - whining time and time again that Mydei needed to take more and more. After all, he was the only human that had permission to take a single thing out of that cave.

And Phainon just.. 

“Wahh.. You can have it all, I don’t mind..” Phainon whined out, sniffling all while he could hear that familiar thumping behind him. A clear red flag that his tail was out again - and happily giving away his emotions in a not very subtle method.

“I’m trying to threaten you, stop being so excited about it.” Mydei hissed out, but his voice lacked any true spite behind it as he immediately laughed over Phainon’s reaction to it. Obviously not too bothered by it at all. 

But Phainon felt his mind pause as he blinked at Mydei, staring at the man nestled in his arms. 

“Ah.. That does remind me somehow..” Phainon started, trailing off a bit languidly as he tried to think of how to broach the subject. But, well… “You do know our children will be little dragons, right..?”

Mydei evidently did not think that - that much was obvious with how he quickly jerked his head backwards to look extremely stunned over those words. 

“Don’t look at me like that.. Little whelps.. You didn’t think humans came out of the eggs, right?” Phainon innocently inquired as he watched Mydei scrunch up his face, clearly baffled by this revelation as Phainon gave a small chuckle over the rapidly changing emotions he was displaying.

Only, Mydei eventually gave a small laugh over those words, “.. I didn’t think about it much, honestly.”

Well.

That kind of made sense, kind of. Not really, Phainon couldn’t imagine not being curious over what exactly was stuffed inside of him if Phainon was in his shoes - but maybe Mydei was just so happy over having his own children his mind had completely skipped over being questioning to focus on the fact he was expecting..

“Ah.. They’ll be so excited to meet you.. It’s okay!” Phainon tried to comfort him, all while hearing his tail smack against the dirt behind him as he thought about how sweet his mate was to just be excited to have children in general with him, “Dragons imprint as children just like ducks!”

Mydei’s face screwed up over that once more - looking more and more stunned all before he shook his head rather disapprovingly, clearly not enjoying that one.

“.. Please don’t compare our children to ducks.” Mydei reprimanded him, but Phainon had to tilt his head over those words.

“What? Why not? Ducks are so cute..” Phainon mumbled out, not really seeing the issue considering the fact ducklings chasing after their mother were very like dragons.. Their children would be doing the same - clinging to his arms and legs, curling onto him lovingly.. “The whelps will cling to you so much.. I’m getting excited again.”

That much was obvious as the thumping only got louder, earning a heavy scowl from Mydei over those words and sounds of him slamming his long scaled appendage into the ground happily, “Put your tail away before someone sees it.”

“Ah! Sorry, sorry!” Phainon had to apologize and obey, even if he didn’t want to. Even if he knew no one was around for miles until the next town, he always had to obey his sweet mate as he continued walking again with Mydei still in arm.

Still oddly content to be carried by the dragon who was more than pleased currently over his mental picture of their children constantly wrapping around Mydei.

“You’re more dog than dragon..” Mydei grumbled out the other hand - words that lacked any true venom as he now heavily leaned into Phainon’s touch. 

Exhausted, Phainon could smell that much on Mydei. As much as he was denying it and claiming he was fine - his body was exhausted as he pressed into Phainon and allowed himself to be carried by his mate. 

“Hehe.. Only for you, my beloved!” Phainon gleefully told him as his hold on Mydei tightened just a bit, “Though, I will say.. I have no idea how to swim, so I wish you luck in teaching our children that if you want to stay by the sea!”

Phainon really didn’t know how.. He had plenty of time to learn with Mydei, though! But he did enjoy the idea of Mydei teaching their children how to swim in the ocean.. He had heard tales of sea dragons, but he himself had never seen one to speak of.

Maybe Mydei would birth the first.. 

“I don’t know how to teach dragons how to swim either?!” Mydei immediately hissed out, making Phainon blankly look  at his mate - head tilting as he walked down that road with precision in every step. Intensely focused on not tripping at all, mainly because he would drop Mydei and never be allowed to do this again.

But also because Mydei would assuredly accuse him of hurting their children (which again was very unlikely..) and scold him for days upon days.

.. Both sounded so painful to think of.

Phainon had to laugh over those words, over the idea of grown dragons floundering around in the waves beside little human Mydei as the man tried to teach them; “Not dragons! Whelplings! Much smaller!”

“.. I don’t know how to teach lizards how to swim.”

“Can we go back to calling them little ducklings..?”
